title: Quadratic equation from a list of terms
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, let $\mathbb F_2$ be the field with two elements, take a finite list of ordered pairs of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, choose a right-hand side $c\in\mathbb F_2$, and let $z\in\mathbb F_2^N$. The quadratic equation formed from that list is satisfied by $z$ if and only if the sum over the list, counting repetitions, of the products $z_a z_b$ for its pairs $(a,b)$ equals $c$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The terms form a finite list of ordered coordinate pairs
The right-hand side lies in $\mathbb F_2$
